title: Mental Health Professional Directory
content: Living with diabetes can be challenging, but you don’t have to navigate it alone. The right mental health provider can make all the difference, and the American Diabetes Association is here to help. The Mental Health Professional Directory makes it easy to find therapists who specialize in supporting individuals living with diabetes. You can even connect with therapists offering telehealth in your state. Enter your zip code below to get started! Locate a therapist in your area who has expertise in diabetes care. If you are a mental health care professional with interest in applying to be listed in the directory, apply now. See how you can still live life to the fullest and thrive with diabetes emotionally and physically. Having gestational diabetes brings its own health and emotional issues. Find ways to make your life easier by simplifying your routine. A healthy body goes a long way to help your mental fitness as well. Hear what others have to say about their diabetes journey. Get connected to the diabetes resources you need. Search by ZIP Code to find services that assist with medical care, mental health care, nutrition education, housing, advocacy, and much more. There are many different types of treatment that can work in various ways to monitor and control blood glucose (blood sugar) levels. The more you know about them, the better off you will be physically and emotionally. Browse articles with information on living your best life with diabetes. Steps for managing your diabetes when you are sick. Prioritize your mental health by knowing the signs of depression in people with diabetes. Get tips on how to deal with the food police—the people who can’t help but ask, “Should you be eating that?” The stress of managing diabetes can take its toll. Try these strategies to ease your stress. Diabetes can mean you are more prone to eating disorders. Learn about the signs. Mood journaling can help your mental health. Get tips on how to get started. Prevent or reduce diabetes burnout by discovering ways to promote your mental health. Sign up for the Healthy Living e-newsletter to receive the latest resources on how to manage and thrive with diabetes. With your support, the American Diabetes Association® can continue our lifesaving work to make breakthroughs in research and provide people with the resources they need to fight diabetes.
